name: connect-ai-xr
description: Your AI XR automation agent. A skill and five starter apps so your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor) builds WebXR apps that open on Meta Quest: AR with passthrough on Quest 3/3S, VR on Quest 2, and a normal 3D view on any computer or phone. Serves them on your network with HTTPS for the headset and checks them in a headless browser.
author: CONNECT AI LAB
